reviews.comment: If you don't go to class you're gonna struggle. He only goes through notes in class so if you miss any information you simply will not have the resource for the exams. Exams are fill-in the blank and are soley based on the in-class notes. Lectures are so boring and the lack of grades make it hard. Don't take.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One exam score is dropped and I got mid to high A's on all exams and will skip the final exam. All exams are open note. I went to class, took notes, printed them then took the exams. Essays are easy too, again use your notes. Extremely easy class if you just take notes and go to class.

If there is any rate my professor review you listen to, let it be this one. Watch the lectures. I spent a total of 3 hours a week watching them. Took detailed notes straight from the presentation. It is not hard at all because he makes it easy. Whoever tells you otherwise, don't listen to them. Warren is one of my favorite professors ever.

This class can be difficult because stata is hard to understand and is coding, if your not tech savy start working on the essays in advance. beyond that the class is pretty easy and Dr. W is such a kind and understanding professor. I had him for two years and he was great!!

Soci420 was one of the harder classes I've taken just because it is a writing intensive stats class that does coding and all that. The prof is amazing this is my second time having Warren Waren and he is so kind and passionate about what he teaches. However, the software we used for coding (Stata) is really dated and can be difficult to use.

Great Prof-connected me with other profs to do research, wrote req letters! 
3 Tests come STRAIGHT from his class lectures-free response q's. Super easy if you attend class and pay attention -if not you're screwed. The end of year presentation isn't hard. Easy A

This class has honestly been great so far I have all As on the 2 exams and 2 essays we've done out of 4 so far, I think he lectures great and keeps things simple & easy to understand. but for the LIFE of me i cannot get help or an email response from this professor Emailed 3 times for help and zero response, Also took over a month to grade exams

Was a very understanding professor and was pretty easy to reach. There were a total of 8 assignments, 4 being exams and 4 being essays. He's exams are open response and can range between 15-60 questions. The essays were pretty easy to complete as long as you Put effort into it and some thing with the exams. I honestly would take his class again.

Professor Waren is an excellent instructor who really cares about his students and what he is teaching. Make sure to go to every lecture because the exams are all based on notes taken from the lecture. The final presentation which is a research proposal, takes time and effort but won't be graded too harshly. Definitely taking another class with him

Professor Waren is the best. Although the class itself can be difficult, he is very caring and wants you to succeed. He explains things very well and is so easy to talk to. Go to class, take good notes, and you will be fine. Probably the nicest and most caring professor I've ever had.

I really enjoyed this class and found all the assignments to be manageable. His teaching style made it really easy to understand the material and his lectures were quite entertaining. He was easy to reach outside of class and always responded to my emails in a timely manner. Dr. Warren was very nice and I highly recommend taking him!

TAKE DR.WAREN! As a sociology major I have been so scared to take SOCI 420. Dr.W truly made this class so much fun. His lectures are amazing and for someone who struggles with math, he made it very simple. If you watch the lectures/HW & study you will do fine. He is so understanding as well! 10/10 would recommend this professor!
Exams are easy but the homework is the insane part. it's legit all busy work. i feel like i'm doing the same stuff over and over again and it takes so long.

Class is a joke tbh. He assigns WAY TOO MUCH work. it's literally you doing the same thing over and over again. He expects you to make this a class a priority over every other single class you're taking. He just assigns busy work and refuses to give anyone a 100. Plus no feedback is great too huh? Yea over him... don't take him.

One of those professors who won't give out 100's because "you could always be better," but refuses to give feedback about what areas you could improve in. Not respectful to students asking about their grades and trying to understand their issues, and doesn't show a desire to help us truly improve. Only recommend if school comes very easily to you.

I don't know why this professor has such a high rating. I am a senior who will likely receive an A in this class and this is one of the most homework intensive and time eating classes I have taken in college, while people in the same class with a different professor do not have nearly as much homework. I do NOT recommend this professor.

He is really easy for this class; it was asynchronous and the lectures handed you everything you needed on a silver platter. Exams are open note, but thats all he has really. Exams and a paper. He is funny, not quite hilarious, but he definitely tries to make a dry topic more interesting and easy for his students. Taking him again for 420.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Good guy overall

This course is writing intensive, so there was homework each week that was very tedious and time consuming, but adequate time is given to complete the assignments and the lowest 2 get dropped! 4 exams, and the lowest one also gets dropped! Dr. Waren is very helpful and understanding with any issues you may be having! Definitely recommend this prof!

Really sweet professor that made class during a pandemic so easy to be a part of. There were some mistakes on our exams, but he quickly corrected them and gave points back. Really patient and understanding. You won't regret taking him!

If this class is required for you, take it with this man! He is seriously the best man and a great teacher. If you have a problem with something, all you have to do is communicate it and he'll fix it. The class was 4 exams (not proctored) he drops your lowest one. There is a homework assignment each week but he drops your lowest 2!

I am a senior and Dr. Waren has made this by far my favorite class I have ever taken at A&M! He truly cares about if students understand the material or not. He does assign a lot of homework, but gives you the entire week to finish and his lectures are so well explained it makes the homework easy! I would recommend him to anyone! Best prof ever!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This course was online which was in interesting take for a major specific course in my opinion. That being said, exams were not difficult at all and did not test over a lot of material so it was very manageable. You have to write about a 15 page proposal but it isn't graded harshly either. Easy A in my opinion if you dedicate the time to it.

This class was already online before TAMU switched to online classes, Waren completely removed 2 tests from the curriculum, tests that could've given students a higher grade. Offered no extra credit. Genuinely just didn't want to teach or grade Emailing him is pointless because he doesn't care, I had to email him at least 3 times to get a response.

Dr. Waren is an incredible teacher who is very passionate about sociology. Although the information could be challenging he did his best to simplify it. There is homework almost every night but it doesn't take long and it prepares you for every test. He also drops the lowest 4 hw grades! Overall he is a great professor and I would take him again.

Dr. Waren was one of my favorite professors. The material was difficult but the hw really helped with understanding. Dr. Waren was also always available to answer questions and emails. If you show up to class and take good notes, you will be prepared to do well in this course. I highly recommend this professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: At first I was skeptical of taking this class, but I am so glad I did. Warren Waren is one of the best professors in Sociology. He cares if you're not getting it and will make sure you do if you ask for help. Also tests are literally the HW which there is alot of. If you go to class where he teaches you everything you'll pass with an A easily.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Waren is one of the best professors at A&M! The class can be a little difficult but he makes the class so interesting and always makes sure the students know what to expect on the exam. class is made up of 3 exams, a paper, and a presentation. He is so caring and loves what he does.
Great professor. Super helpful and caring.

Dr. Waren's class is all lecture, BUT his lectures are always very interesting and easy to learn from. His tests are also very easy as long as you study the class notes. I studied on average for about an hour and a half for each test and got an A. would absolutely take him again.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He's an amazing professor and I would absolutely take him again. The material can be difficult but he teaches it in a way that is easy to comprehend. He is very accommodating to any needs you may have. You will have to study thoroughly for each exam but if you go to class and take notes you'll make good grades. Expect 4 exams and a paper.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Would take again

reviews.comment: Absolutely love him. This class sounds boring and he makes it so interesting. He is an amazing professor that cares for his students. Attend class, pay attention, and take good notes and youll be set for each exam (as long as you study hard). 4 Exams, no final, and a paper is what youll see. Take him and no one else for Soci 220!
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Even though this was a 400 level course, Dr. Waren made it so easy! We did have homework after most every class but it wasn't hard, just monotonous. It really does help you learn though! Stresses that tests will be difficult, but he makes it so easy to do well!

Professor Waren is by far one of my favorite professors that I've had. He does give lots of homework but I found that it really does help with understanding the material. I was going through a lot while I was in his class and he was SUPER understanding and helpful. For a class that has the potential to be very difficult, he makes it seem easy.
Great professor, 100% recommend!! The class can get a little confusing, especially if you skip, but he's always willing to help. He's a nice guy who genuinely cares about his students.

You do NOT want to miss lecture for this class or you will be totally lost. If you pay attention to lectures & take notes, it's pretty easy stuff. There is homework due every class that takes quite a bit of time, but it is very helpful for the tests- almost verbatim. Great prof, lenient, funny,  inspirational, and really cares about his students

Although attendance is not mandatory if you skip class you will not know what is going on and find yourself struggling. Waren is a great prof and I really enjoyed his class, you won't regret taking him! Do the homework its the best way to prep for the tests and boost your overall average! Good luck Ags!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Waren is the best. He's really quirky and kinda dorky, but he genuinely cares that you learn. He goes slow on the slides to make sure everyone gets it down and clearly explains the concepts. 420 is a statistics class, so it's basically all math, but he doesn't make it all that hard. Do the hw and you'll learn the concepts; Waren is great. 10/10

He's not available for office hours, sometimes responds to emails, funny in class, pay attention to lectures and review the material alot. Instead of buying the textbook for the two chapters you use it for, get a study group and share the sections.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Waren is a great professor. His exams were alright, they weren't too difficult but you will have to study for them. He's a fair grader and makes the class very enjoyable. 3 Exams, a presentation, and a 8-page paper are what you'll be expecting. His exams are mostly free responses, while the presentation and paper is about your research topic.
